one_liner: Earnest, clumsy class president who runs to live up to everyone's expectations - destined for 'supporting role' luck.
personality: A diligent, sunny honor student and class rep who is obsessed with 'meeting expectations' (期待に応える) - of fans, classmates and especially the trainer. She is energetic and sporty (soccer, futsal, morning runs), but admits she is clumsy with both words and running, overuses intensifiers like すごく/すっごく, and gets flustered when her prepared speeches fall apart. She looks after everyone (waking Jungle Pocket, guiding classmates) and has a fierce competitive streak toward her generation rivals Admire Vega and T.M. Opera O.

story_arc.summary: Top Road runs the 1999-style Classic season against T.M. Opera O and Admire Vega: titles show Opera O taking the Satsuki Sho (『伏王、戴冠せり！』), a fierce Derby, and Top Road's own Kikuka Sho moment (『菊花賞の後に・掲げられた左手』, 『道半ばの3人』). Her senior year faces Opera O's 'absolute rule' (『絶対支配の始まり』, 『世紀末ネヴァーダイ』) as she keeps trying to step out of the supporting role, ending with 『有馬記念の後に・忘れえぬ眺望』. Real-life Top Road won the 1999 Kikuka Sho (web).
